WITH manager_awards AS (
    SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country
), shares AS (
    SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count,
           CAST(award_count AS REAL) / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share
    FROM manager_awards
)
SELECT manager_id, death_country, award_count, share
FROM shares
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
